actionable_sentences: The API call must include the appointment_id parameter with the value '90123456'.
The appointment_id must be provided as a string value.
The API should return a status field indicating the result of the cancellation.
lifted_nl: The CancelRegistration operation must include the appointment_id parameter with the value '90123456'.
The CancelRegistration operation shall provide the appointment_id parameter as a string value.
The CancelRegistration operation shall return a status field that indicates the result of the cancellation.
operations.LABEL: FUNCTIONAL_SPEC
operations.Precondition: The appointment_id '90123456' must correspond to an existing appointment record in the system.
operations.Postcondition: The API returns a status field indicating whether the cancellation was successful (e.g., 'cancelled'), confirming the appointment has been removed from the schedule.
assumptions: The appointment with ID '90123456' exists and is currently active in the system.
The CancelRegistration API endpoint is accessible and functional.
invariants: The appointment_id parameter remains unchanged throughout the operation.
The returned status accurately reflects the cancellation outcome.
